dct_title_s: Spatialized 100m school age population grid for Togo, by educational level and sex, 2020
dct_description_sm: This GeoTIFF file contains 12 bands presenting the school age population for Togo in 2020. It was constructed using constrained UN-adjusted spatialized age and sex population estimates for 2020 by [WorldPop](https://hub.worldpop.org/geodata/summary?id=50548"Togo 100m Age structures in 2020 with country total adjusted to match the corresponding UNDP estimate"), by applying the methodology published by [IIEP-UNESCO](https://unesdoc.unesco.org/ark:/48223/pf0000379198 "Estimating school-age populations by applying Sprague multipliers to raster data") (2021). The bands contain information for Female, Male, and Total, for Pre-primary, Primary, Lower Secondary, and Upper secondary, reconstructed from single years of age using ISCED information on starting age and duration included in [UIS](http://data.uis.unesco.org/ "UIS.Stat"). The correspondence is included below: * Band 1: Pre-primary Female * Band 2: Pre-primary Male * Band 3: Pre-primary Total * Band 4: Primary Female * Band 5: Primary Male * Band 6: Primary Total * Band 7: Lower secondary Female * Band 8: Lower secondary Male * Band 9: Lower secondary Total * Band 10: Upper secondary Female * Band 11: Upper secondary Male * Band 12: Upper secondary Total The boundaries used for the clipping of the resulting calculations came from the [United Nations Second Administrative Level Boundary program](https://www.unsalb.org/data/tgo "Togo").
